summary_statistics: Median=statistics.median; p95=nearest-rank ceil(.95*N); sums are observed simulated-step costs, not real-time throughput. Profile-on/off runs remain explicitly separated.
provenance_limit: Most early prototype runs did not retain a per-run complete source/binary fingerprint. Existing recorded hashes are preserved, never backfilled as if captured then. Full argv was not retained for every early run. Frozen diagnostic capture does retain historical engine archive/source/binary hashes; no claim those binaries were reproduced during collation.
